prerequisites: Frozen implementation, comparators, input and beta hashes
All four leagues evaluated once without rerun or tuning
promotion.primary: Per candidate, every league, and each comparator separately: delta LL < -1e-12 AND delta multiclass Brier < -1e-12.
promotion.classGuards: Every HOME/DRAW/AWAY versus each comparator on the fixed primary population: recall delta >= -0.05-1e-12; ECE delta <= 0.01+1e-12; one-vs-rest Brier delta <= 1e-12.
promotion.coverage: Fixed comparator intersection U contains at least 100 fixtures and >=80% of full league cohort; candidate predicts 100% of U; all full-cohort IDs retained; zero FAIL/INVALID; all three actual classes present in U.
promotion.nullHandling: Null required recall/ECE or missing primary probabilities => INSUFFICIENT, never silently pass. Precision null is reported, not a promotion guard.
promotion.outcome: ELIGIBLE_FOR_CTO_PROMOTION_REVIEW only if all four leagues pass all gates; otherwise SCREEN_NO, INSUFFICIENT, FAIL or INVALID as applicable. No model promotion or automatic Forward migration.
promotion.multipleCandidates: Evaluate all F1/F2/F3 separately; no composite winner, league cherry-picking, unregistered ensemble or automatic choice among passing candidates.
promotion.exposed2024: DESCRIPTIVE_CHECK_ONLY; report numeric metrics and differences, no promotion eligibility from these data
promotion.rationale: Fixed conservative descriptive eligibility guardrails, not a significance test: common denominators, both probability scores improve, class recall capped at 5 percentage-point loss and ECE at 1 point. No claim that these constants were empirically optimized.

independentHoldoutCandidate.evaluationAuthorization: Separate CTO approval after protocol and algorithm freeze, cohort seal, integrity and exposure checks

holdout.exposureDetectedAction: Report contamination; do not relabel exposed data as independent or inspect metrics to decide what to keep.

backbone.name: FROZEN_V2_H2
backbone.fitPolicy: For each target and each beta-training example, fresh causal frozen H2 fit using its same-league 365d/48h result pool and unchanged 30/5/5, universe, objective, optimizer, caps and PASS rules. Offset must never come from a full-season fit containing that example or later results.
backbone.adapterPolicy: Existing season guards stay untouched. Any future V3-scoped season adapter must preserve identities, not relabel 2025 as 2024, and pass equivalence tests on 2023/2024 before authorization; no 2025 access here.

aggregation.pool: For feature f independently, M_f(T) is eligible base-history matches with valid non-null f for BOTH exact team IDs. Completeness of unregistered features must not affect the candidate.
aggregation.validity: Exactly one matching provider type per expected team; finite nonnegative number or trimmed decimal numeric string; shots/SOT integer. Zero is present. Null/absent/block unavailable are missing. Duplicate identity/type, negative/invalid/nonfinite raw values or hash mismatch are INVALID, not dropped.
aggregation.mapping: Home team For=f_home and Against=f_away; away team For=f_away and Against=f_home. Do not negate Against. League reference counts both team For values once per match.
aggregation.means: n_tf=count of M_f(T) involving t; muFor_tf=sum For/n_tf; muAgainst_tf=sum Against/n_tf; L_f=sum over M_f(T)(f_home+f_away)/(2*|M_f(T)|). All arithmetic means, uniform weights, all venues.
aggregation.normalization: zFor_tf=ln(muFor_tf)-ln(L_f); zAgainst_tf=ln(muAgainst_tf)-ln(L_f), mathematically log ratio. No epsilon, clipping, standardization, feature mean shrinkage or imputation.
aggregation.zeroRule: Any required mean or reference exactly zero => PASS_NONPOSITIVE_FEATURE_MEAN; nonfinite arithmetic => FAIL_NUMERICAL. Min-count check precedes means. Invalid raw values are INVALID_INPUT before aggregation.
aggregation.featureIndependentMasks: F1 only inspects xG; F2 only shots/SOT; F3 reuses the same per-feature pools, not a joint-complete new pool. Every required feature must independently meet both team min counts.
aggregation.order: Matches kickoffUtc then numeric fixtureId; per match home then away; features xG,shots,sot; coefficients For then Against; all scalar reductions left-to-right binary64.

fitting.scope: Separate league x candidate beta; no pooling, no warm starts, no cross-candidate initialization
fitting.objective: J(beta)=(1/(2N))*sum_i[exp(o_iH+X_iH dot beta)-y_iH*(o_iH+X_iH dot beta)+exp(o_iA+X_iA dot beta)-y_iA*(o_iA+X_iA dot beta)]+(0.01/2)*sum_j beta_j^2; o=ln(causal frozen H2 rate); omit log-factorial constants.
fitting.parameters: Unconstrained real beta, shared between home/away equations, no intercept, no feature interaction or draw coefficient; H2 parameters never optimized with beta.
fitting.optimizer: Deterministic damped Newton with unpivoted Cholesky solve H*d=-g; column/index order ascending; no jitter, alternate solver or restart.
fitting.convergence: At initialization and after accepted updates, max(abs(g))<=1e-7; max accepted updates=100. Small objective change alone is not convergence.
fitting.lineSearch: At each update test alpha=2^(-j), j=0..59; first finite positive-rate trial with J(beta+alpha*d)<=J(beta)+1e-4*alpha*dot(g,d) accepted. Reject overflow/underflow trials without clipping. If none: FAIL_LINE_SEARCH.
fitting.failure: Nonpositive Cholesky pivot, nonfinite accepted state or g dot d>=0 before convergence => FAIL_NUMERICAL. 100 updates without convergence => FAIL_NON_CONVERGENCE. No beta=0/H2 fallback after failure.
fitting.insufficient: Fewer than 30 valid two-equation causal examples => PASS_INSUFFICIENT_FIT / experiment INSUFFICIENT; no class-count gate for Poisson fitting.
fitting.trainingRates: Finite positive likelihood rates; no target cap of 10 inside beta likelihood. Prediction output rate cap remains 10.

phases.initialFit: Only season-2023 examples with kickoff<boundary AND kickoff+48h<boundary. Each example is predicted from its own C(i) causal history and feature state, then its FT goals become fitting labels. Retain every excluded example/reason in full fit census.
phases.internalCheck: All season-2023 targets with kickoff>=boundary, ordered chronologically, using initial beta frozen before check. Pre-boundary examples not yet 48h available remain audited but are not moved into check.
phases.finalDevelopmentFit: Once, from beta=0, all eligible season-2023 causal examples after all season-2023 results satisfy the research lag. Same estimator, not selection; fit and parameter/input hashes sealed before any 2024 candidate results.
phases.exposed2024: Use that final-2023 beta unchanged. No beta fit on 2024 labels; no specification/hyperparameter adaptation.
phases.holdout2025: Use identical final-2023 beta and hash; no refit using 2024 or 2025 labels. Only after separate identity/completeness/exposure seal, independence certification and CTO approval: one evaluation.
phases.causalUpdates: Earlier 2024/2025 results/features may update later same-season H2 and feature states only after fixed lag/window; never beta, hyperparameter or selection. No season-2022 warmup ingestion.
phases.fitPass: Legal example PASS omitted from beta likelihood with IDs/reasons and full denominator audit. Any example FAIL/INVALID blocks that league-candidate fit, rather than shrinking training data.

probabilities.model: Independent Poisson, no Dixon-Coles or temperature/DRAW correction
probabilities.rates: Require finite 0<lambda_home,lambda_away<=10; positive >10 => PASS; nonfinite/nonpositive computed => FAIL_NUMERICAL
probabilities.grid: For each marginal start P0=exp(-lambda), recurse Pk=P(k-1)*lambda/k; include k>=1 and extend until 1-cumulative<=1e-12 with k<=199. If tail unmet at cap: INVALID. Sum joint in ascending home-score then away-score order.
probabilities.mass: Require Z finite positive and abs(1-Z)<=3e-12; normalize joint once by Z. HOME i>j, DRAW i=j, AWAY i<j. Final probabilities finite in [0,1], sum error<=1e-10. Evaluator does not repair.
probabilities.classRule: Ordinary argmax with exact-tie HOME then DRAW then AWAY; no threshold
probabilities.arithmetic: IEEE754 binary64, no randomness or rounded comparison inputs

comparisons.population: For each league/phase, N is every frozen target. Before candidate execution and without consulting outcomes/features, seal U={IDs where frozen V1 and frozen H2 both PREDICTED} and comparator probabilities/hashes. Never import V2 paired IDs as V3 universe.
comparisons.candidateMissing: If candidate does not predict every ID in U, primary LL/Brier/class metrics are null with INCOMPLETE_PRIMARY_COVERAGE; do not drop targets or substitute comparator probabilities. Optional common-subset metric not produced in this design.
comparisons.extraPredictions: Predictions outside U retained as operational evidence only, never added to primary comparison denominator.

metrics.logLoss: mean(-ln(max(pActual,1e-15))), scoring-only floor; report floor-hit count
metrics.brier: mean(sum_c(p_c-y_c)^2), no division by class count
metrics.ece: Per-class 10 equal bins [0,.1),...,[.9,1]; ECE=sum(n_b/|U|)*abs(meanP_b-frequency_b); empty bins retained with null means; n_b<20 flagged low sample
metrics.undefined: No required-class actual samples => required recall null and promotion INSUFFICIENT
metrics.delta: candidate minus comparator on identical U, unrounded

comparisons.aggregation: Each league separately, both comparators; no pooled historical/Forward or league-weighted winner score

requiredBeforeExecution: Seal all source/test/input/comparator hashes before any V3 outputs
Synthetic field reversal, candidate isolation and per-feature mask tests

beta=0 rates equal H2 within 1e-12; probability mapper equivalent to frozen H2 within 1e-10
